VPN server is running

This server implements the Packet Handoff Protocol for virtual private networks (PHPVPN). The client application can be configured by following the instructions below.

Warning: The default value of SERVER_SECRET is still being used. The SERVER_SECRET variable in this script must be set to a secure value immediately. A secure value can be created using the Generate key button below.

Secure hexadecimal key:

Step 1 - Download and install the client app

To connect to this VPN server, the client application for your operating system must first be selected in the list below, downloaded and installed. The source code can be opened from the same list.

Download

After installation, the PHPVPN client app should be launched. On Windows, it can be opened from the system tray or located by searching for phpvpn.exe in the Start menu. A similar procedure can be followed on macOS and Linux.

Step 2A - Configure the client app

If a configuration file has been provided by your administrator, its contents can be pasted into the configuration form accessed through Edit Config.

Step 2B - Use the Configuration Wizard

If no configuration file has been provided, the Configuration Wizard can be opened from the client menu. The following steps should then be completed:

  • The VPN server URL should be set to the address of this page:
  • The connection to the server can be checked by clicking the "Verify & continue" button in the Configuration Wizard. If the connection fails, the HTTP request headers can be viewed using and then copied into the Configuration Wizard.
  • The correct Server Secret should be entered, or the default used if applicable.
  • The correct IP Address and the corresponding Access Token should be entered, or the defaults used if applicable.
  • The default Communication Contracts should be generated.
  • The Server Secret and, where required, the IP Address and Access Token should be provided by your administrator.

HTTP headers

The HTTP request headers received by this script may be incomplete. For exact values, your browser's developer tools can be opened with F12, and the request headers can be copied from the Network tab.

SERVER_SECRET copied successfully

The key generated by JavaScript in the web browser has been copied to the clipboard. You should now replace the value of SERVER_SECRET in the server script with this key to improve the security of the VPN server.
